usedFor: FlowFast holds cards, boards and comments, and viaSocket utilities starts another workflow through “Flow in Flow” when “New Card” appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Card” in FlowFast, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: Each new card can start a separate workflow, so the follow-up steps live in one place.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires the ID of the workflow to run, and “New Card” in FlowFast is polling.
